Pinned cache contains 708 features; 1 of these location records have entirely matched declared-source member IDs. Source-ID correspondence does not independently approve local geographic purpose, original-footprint retention, administrative reforms or settlement/rank. Exact review stays open until those tests have sourced outcomes.

method: All 849 original features of five complete families and every retained Natural Earth country polygon tested with Shapely covered_by at authenticated native centres. Original geometry, no repair/buffer. Cohort holds apply to whole current-location owner across both packages. Country absence alone is not a veto.
